label: Ikony · Disco (70s)
desc: Prst ukazuje nahoru do rohu, diagonální švih k boku, houpání boků, otočka, finální ukázání.
desc_en: A finger pointing up to the corner, a diagonal sweep to the hip, swaying hips, a spin, a closing point.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

beats.prompt: the dancer plants the feet wide, pushes the hips to one side and points one index finger high up to the opposite corner, the other hand on the hip, and holds the point
the pointing arm sweeps diagonally down across the body to the opposite hip and back up to the corner, hips rocking with the sweep, and ends pointing up again
the hips sway from side to side in rhythm with one hand on the hip and the other arm rolling in front of the chest, and end with weight on one leg
the dancer spins a full turn with one arm raised overhead, and ends facing the camera with the arm still up
the dancer points high to the corner once more with the head thrown back and the chest out, and freezes in the pose
